I am a young man here in Balaka, and this small plot near my home is where I grow my maize to feed my family. The rains have been unreliable these past seasons, so I must be careful with what little money I have. I will buy a small bag of fertilizer on the AIP subsidy if I can get the coupon, and I will use hybrid seed because it yields better even on my small piece of land. I have no money for pesticides or irrigation, so I depend on my own hands and the help of my wife, and I intercrop with pigeon peas to protect the soil.
